item.title: Davis Genealogy Club Library Hours — Wed Aug 19, 1:00 PM — Davis Senior Center
item.description:
Library Hours: Wednesdays, 1 – 3:30 p.m. (excluding holidays) This group assists and maintains the Senior Center’s extensive Genealogy Library, and in addition, hosts monthly lectures and meetings. During library hours, members are available to assist you with accessing research materials. Computer access is also available in the library for research purposes.
Source: The Dirt

item.title: Davis Farmers Market — Wed Aug 19, 4:00 PM — Central Park
item.description:
Year-round at Central Park in downtown Davis, thousands gather each week to shop for what is grown, raised, and made locally at our markets. We are dedicated to bringing farmers right to your table, so we stay open rain or shine. Walk rows of stalls lined with an array of fruits and vegetables, including certified organic produce, choice meats, chicken, seafood, wine, local eggs and honey. Choose from a variety of fresh-baked goods, plants, flowers and gifts. Enjoy a picnic from one of our many food stands, made from market ingredients. See the vendor list here: https://www.davisfarmersmarket.org/our-sellers/ Farmers Market Hours Central Park: Saturdays 8a–1p (year-round), and Wednesdays 3p–6p (September through March); 4p–8p (April through August) UC Davis – North Quad: Wednesdays 10a–1:30p (fall and spring quarters) Sutter Davis Hospital: Thursdays 10a–1p (May through September) Sutter Medical Center, Sacramento: Thursdays 2:30p–5:30p
Source: The Dirt

item.title: Pub Quiz (Trivia) hosted by Dr. Andy — Wed Aug 19, 7:00 PM — Sudwerk Brewing Co.
item.description:
Sudwerk Trivia is a free, first come-first serve, all-ages event. Join us for a fun-filled evening of brain-teasing questions and friendly competition at Sudwerk’s Pub Quiz every Wednesday from 7-9pm! Put your knowledge to the test and gather your friends for a night of laughter and excitement. Location: 2001 2nd Street, Davis, CA 95618 You do not have to be 21+ to participate in trivia. There is no drink minimum.

item.title: Family Camp 2026 — Thu Aug 20, 1:00 PM — CA
item.description: Davis Forest School is hosting our 4-day, 3-night Family Camp from August 20th-23rd this summer! Join us for a nurturing and nourishing retreat created for both children and adults to slow down, reconnect, and immerse ourselves in the beauty of nature together. Our camp will be held at Bear Valley Y Camp in Nevada City. This site is nestled in the breathtaking High Sierra, offering a stunning natural setting for outdoor adventures and family fun. There are scenic hiking trails that wind through towering pines and alpine meadows, providing many opportunities for exploration. This is our cozy community gathering that is quickly becoming our signature annual event! item.title: Picnic in the Park at Davis Farmers Market – Wednesday Evenings (50th Anniversary Year) — Wed Oct 28, 4:00 PM — Central Park
item.description:
The beloved Picnic in the Park season is back at the Davis Farmers Market starting Wednesday, April 1, 2026! Every Wednesday evening through August 26, the market expands to 4:00 – 8:00 PM, turning Central Park into the perfect spot for a relaxed picnic dinner. Shop fresh produce, artisan goods, and a wide variety of prepared foods from your favorite vendors. Enjoy local craft beer, wine, and brand new this year – mead! Each week features live music and children’s activities, creating a festive, family-friendly atmosphere. Bring blankets, lawn chairs, and reusable bags. It’s the ideal way to unwind, connect with neighbors, and support local farmers and food makers. This year is extra special as the Davis Farmers Market celebrates its 50th Anniversary! Don’t miss the big anniversary celebration on Saturday, August 1, 2026. New in 2026: The Market Memories Cookbook (presale now at davis-farmers-market). Highlights Include:

item.title: Blood on the Clocktower at Blue Note — Wed Sep 2, 5:00 PM
item.description:
Yolo County Board Game Gathering The first Wednesday of every month, we play _Blood on the Clocktower_, a social deduction game in the vein of Werewolf/Mafia/The Resistance, with a few twists!
We'll have a circle of chairs reserved inside Blue Note, near the back, with a Yolo County Board Game Gathering sign on the table. Just say hello, and we'll show you some games, pull some players together, and get to having fun!
We also usually have a few tables of players playing other board games, if social deduction isn't your bag!
Get a feel for Blood on the Clocktower here: https://youtu.be/4sfa8_kNxsQ
Source: Meetup: Yolo Board Game Gathering

item.title: Picnic in the Park at Davis Farmers Market – Wednesday Evenings (50th Anniversary Year) — Wed Oct 21, 4:00 PM — Central Park
item.description:
The beloved Picnic in the Park season is back at the Davis Farmers Market starting Wednesday, April 1, 2026! Every Wednesday evening through August 26, the market expands to 4:00 – 8:00 PM, turning Central Park into the perfect spot for a relaxed picnic dinner. Shop fresh produce, artisan goods, and a wide variety of prepared foods from your favorite vendors. Enjoy local craft beer, wine, and brand new this year – mead! Each week features live music and children’s activities, creating a festive, family-friendly atmosphere. Bring blankets, lawn chairs, and reusable bags. It’s the ideal way to unwind, connect with neighbors, and support local farmers and food makers. This year is extra special as the Davis Farmers Market celebrates its 50th Anniversary! Don’t miss the big anniversary celebration on Saturday, August 1, 2026. New in 2026: The Market Memories Cookbook (presale now at davis-farmers-market). Highlights Include:

item.title: Weekly Game Night at Blue Note — Wed Oct 28, 5:00 PM
item.description:
Yolo County Board Game Gathering Update 8/14/25: **We're still active**, but we primarily use Discord to chat and plan events. (See group description for invite link.)
We still meet every Wednesday for board games at Blue Note Brewing Company. We'll have a handful of tables reserved near the back; just look for the pile of board games.
People usually start arriving around 5pm, and games start whenever people are ready. Blue Note closes at 9pm, and although we have a 5-10 minute grace period there, you should be in the process of final scoring by 9, or else pack it up and play again another day.
Game night is open to all ages! Blue Note is a brewery, not a bar, so there's no restriction against minors. In addition to their crafted-in-house beer selection, water and sodas are available.
You're not required to buy anything in order to join us, but we do encourage you to support local businesses. Blue Note's chef team makes a mean pizza, and there are other nearby downtown restaurants

item.title: Hope Café: Finding Connection — Thu Aug 20, 6:30 PM — International House Davis
item.description:
Join us on two nights, August 20th and September 25th, to celebrate the start of fall with an evening at the International House Davis, designed to build connection and community. Hope Café is a mix of a workshop and a party, opening up a space where live music, creative activities, and guided conversations invite you to reflect and develop a new connection.
Activities include: community story sharing and playful creative exercises until 8:30 PM, live world jazz by Nick Carvajal and Jim Frink, and complimentary food and drinks provided by the Davis Food Co-Op.
Tickets operate on a sliding scale of $15 – $25. Free tickets are available upon request by emailing office@internationalhousedavis.org. This event is open to community members ages 14 and older.
To purchase tickets, visit: https://secure.internationalhousedavis.org/nx/portal/neonevents/events?path=%2Fportal%2Fevents%2F49102
Source: Hate-Free Together

item.title: Peace Picnic — Sat Sep 26, 11:00 AM — Fern Park
item.description:
The Woodland Ecumenical and Multi-faith Ministries (WEMM), an interfaith council consisting of faith communities, is hosting the annual Peace Picnic. The “Community Interfaith Peace Picnic” in Woodland, is an event that involves bringing together people from various religious backgrounds to promote peace, understanding, and collaboration. The picnic features meaningful conversations, games, and several speakers.
The event will occur on September 26th, at 11:00 AM. Complimentary Pakistani food will be served. Drinks will also be included.
The event is free for all. All ages are welcome.
For more information, visit: https://woodlandwemm.org/
Source: Hate-Free Together

item.title: Day in Downtown — Sun Sep 27, 3:00 AM
item.description:
Spend a full day exploring Day in Downtown – a vibrant, free street event bringing together local talent and community! From 10 AM to 4 PM, browse a diverse lineup of vendors on E Street (between 3rd & 4th St.), including:
Vintage clothing & unique finds Local artists, makers, and creators Davis brick-and-mortar shops Non-profits sharing their work Music by DRC Special spots like Sophia’s Thai Kitchen for tasty bites
Discover one-of-a-kind items, support small businesses and local organizations, and enjoy the lively energy of downtown Davis. Perfect for a relaxed Sunday outing with friends, family, or solo shopping. Bring reusable bags and comfy shoes!
Source: Davis Downtown

item.title: Davis Neighbors' Night Out — Sun Oct 4
item.description:
Join the City of Davis, Yolo County, ASUCD, and UC Davis in celebrating community during Davis Neighbors’ Night Out. Davis Neighbors’ Night Out is a celebration of our community and a great opportunity for neighbors to get to know one another. Connected neighborhoods create safer and more caring places to live
Events include potlucks, neighborhood games and activities and gatherings of neighbors to meet in the street for good conversation.
Davis Neighbors’ Night Out is open to all ages and is free to participate in.
Neighbors, neighborhood associations, apartment complexes, etc., are encouraged to be an “Event Sponsor.” If you’re interested in becoming an event sponsor, visit: https://www.cityofdavis.org/city-hall/city-manager-s-office/community-events/davis-neighbors-night-out
Source: Hate-Free Together

item.title: Healing Arts 6-Session Workshop — Fri Oct 9, 10:00 AM
item.description:
Pence Adult Art Programs The Pence’s 6-session Healing Arts workshop uses art as a healing language for those experiencing grief from the loss of a loved one. Through the process of art making, participants will have opportunities for discussion, education, and connecting with peers in a safe and supportive space in the Pence Learning Center under the guidance of facilitators Amy Vidra and Lyndsey Rocca.
REGISTRATION ONLINE IS REQUIRED IN ADVANCE through the Pence Gallery's website, and space is limited to the first 8 participants who register. Participants must be 18 or older, and no art experience is necessary. This program is generously sponsored by Bob & Joanne Andresen.
Healing Arts 6-Session Workshop Fridays\, 10\-11:45 AM \| Oct\. 9\, 16\, 23\, 30 & Nov\. 6\, 13 $25 Members, $35 Non-Members (all materials included)
